proposals.evidence: Turner gives Punjabi bhinn difference, Assamese/Bengali bhin separate and Maithili bhīn under bhinna different. Dotyali bhinā̃i and Majhi bhinde match the bhin- adjective with local adverbial/inflectional endings. The d-bearing Majhi form is a qualified comparison rather than a claim of a regular sound law.
